summary: Iteration 18 – PIN → password migration verification (backend + frontend, PREVIEW only). Backend pytest suite (8/8) covers: legacy PIN 1234 now rejected (401), 5-failure lockout returning 429 (correct password also blocked until Mongo staff_login_attempts is cleared), weak passwords refused (400), driver role refused (400), kitchen token cannot manage passwords (403), and GET /auth/staff/roles reports credential='password' for manager/kitchen/phone. Frontend UI verified on the preview: /staff/login renders staff-password-input as HTML type=password, the staff-password-toggle switches type=password<->text correctly, staff-pin-submit stays aria-disabled=true when empty, wrong PIN 1234 shows the server message 'Mot de passe incorrect – 4 tentatives restantes'. Manager login (Preview-Manager-2026!) lands on /staff with all 5 nav buttons (kitchen/phone-orders/customers/closing/admin); each sub-screen (Cuisine, Clients, Clôture, Administration) renders without red-screen error. Admin → Sécurité shows Badge 'Mot de passe défini' for manager/kitchen/phone, no security-legacy-warning is present. security-save-phone stays aria-disabled=true with a weak password AND with a mismatching confirmation; setting phone role to Preview-Phone-2026! with matching confirmation succeeds with success toast 'Mot de passe enregistré – l'ancien code ne fonctionne plus'. Kitchen login (Preview-Cuisine-2026!) lands on /staff, has no staff-go-admin / staff-go-closing buttons, and direct navigation to /staff/admin is refused (redirects back to /staff). Phone login (Preview-Phone-2026!) lands on /phone-orders. Hidden staff access: from the Plus tab, a short tap on more-restaurant-name does nothing (stays on /more) and a ~4.5 s mouse-down hold navigates to /staff/login. Mongo staff_login_attempts collection cleared at start AND end of run – UI is not blocked. Sandbox DB verified: phone role has password_hash and no pin_hash. Manager password is unchanged (still 'Preview-Manager-2026!'). No orders/prints/emails/products were touched.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/staff_auth.py: 5-failure lockout is enforced per client + persisted in staff_login_attempts with locked_until; even the correct password returns 429 while locked. Verified.
frontend/app/staff/login.tsx uses secureTextEntry={!show} which maps to HTML input type=password on Web – confirmed via DOM inspection.
frontend/app/(tabs)/more.tsx wraps the restaurant name in a Pressable with onLongPress + delayLongPress={4000} and no onPress, so short taps are silently ignored. Confirmed behaviorally.

frontend/app/staff/admin/security.tsx client-side passwordOk mirror matches the server rule (>=10 chars, letters+digits+special, no leading/trailing whitespace); Save button aria-disabled correctly reflects both weakness and mismatch.
